newObjects.detail: Function `public.document_progress(p_document uuid, p_filter text, p_page integer, p_size integer)` can be executed by the `authenticated` role as a `SECURITY DEFINER` function via `/rest/v1/rpc/document_progress`. Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.

Revoke `EXECUTE` or switch it to `SECURITY INVOKER` if that is not intentional.
